selection_rules.random_k: uniform_without_replacement from shared valid pool, K=k_fixed
selection_rules.top_k_hard: top k_fixed by candidate_score, relation name breaks ties
selection_rules.coverage_adaptive_k: K_i = clip(smallest K covering coverage_tau of negative_mass, k_min, k_max); then take top K_i
selection_rules.soft_mix: 6 uniform from the full pool + 3 draws from Top-9 via (1-rho)/|S| + rho * m_S(r), rho=0.33, without replacement; leftover slots fall back to the remaining ranked pool
selection_rules.calibrated: same negatives as soft_mix; lambda_q = lambda_0 * clip(1 - beta * top9_mass, lambda_min/lambda_0, 1)

training_protocol.train_qa: full paper task file; listed negatives from frozen sampler IDs
